views.rationale: AAPL's gross margin is expected to outperform BA's due to lower revenue in 2020, partially offset by higher charges in 2020 related to COVID-19 impacts (BA 10-Q)
AMZN's cost of sales is expected to outperform BAC's due to a 25% year-over-year increase in cost of sales (AMZN 10-Q)
CAT's sales and revenues are expected to underperform CVX's due to lower sales volume driven by lower end-user demand for equipment and services (CAT 10-Q)
GOOGL's 29% revenue growth outpaces GS's 17% growth
GOOGL's 29% revenue growth far exceeds JNJ's 2% decline
KO's 9% decline in net operating revenues is less severe than LIN's 13% decline
JPM's 3% increase in net revenue outpaces KO's 9% decline in net operating revenues

NVDA's gross margin decreased to 62.6% from 63.6% due to charges related to the Mellanox acquisition and lower margins in Gaming, partially offset by a shift in product mix with higher Data Center and lower Automotive sales, compared to MSFT's gross margin increase of 15% driven by growth across each of its segments and a reduction in depreciation expense.
